profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker DT. Its own site describes it as an observability platform built for the age of AI, combining observability, AI, automation, and application security in one product. The company says the platform is meant to help customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and turn data into decisions and autonomous actions.

The site positions Dynatrace as an AI-powered observability leader and states that the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using what it calls deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. That framing is attributed on the site to Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC. A customer quote on the site says the Dynatrace AI engine provides early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, cutting root cause identification from hours to minutes.

Beyond the company profile, the record lists no tracked products and no MCP servers for Dynatrace. It does carry a litigation exposure entry for Massachusetts with a count of 191.
